items.title: Bound unattended host startup and execution
items.context: Require positive unattended readiness before automatic spawn. Add configurable first-output watchdog plus total deadline, propagate abort/kill/reap/capacity release, and distinguish auth/interactive/no-output/startup timeout from total timeout. Use deterministic fake child processes only; host=fake is never production assurance.

items.title: Complete and verify candidate routing specificity contracts
items.context: Preserve the existing maxDocumentFrequencyRatio implementation while proving generic lattice/proofbound/core/handlers terms cannot force full corpus by themselves. Exact relatedDocs, exact paths, registry refs, typed risk signals and reviewer-bound evidence must remain candidates; truncation escalates only when relevance/ranking is affected; artifact explanations and shadow/warn/enforce behavior must agree.
